fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects patterns found in process executions cause by China Chopper like tiny (ASPX) webshells
fields.name: Chopper Webshell Process Pattern
fields.notes:
- To move around freely without attracting too much attention, attackers often use reliable software (one of the favorites is psexec) that looks normal in an enterprise environment.
- Use the following aggregate to easily group by endpoint: `| group array_agg_distinct(dst.ip.address) by endpoint.name, src.process.cmdline`
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "\w3wp.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\w3wp.exe") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "&ipconfig&echo" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "&quser&echo" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "&whoami&echo" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "&c:&echo" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "&cd&echo" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "&dir&echo" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "&echo [E]" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "&echo [S]")))
